body_text.text: Sections are higher-level UI structures that span the entire screen width and allow easily organising content in a responsive layout grid. They simplify the workflow of channel designers by allowing them to create complete UI views without getting caught up in layout details.

page_section_element_body.text: In case you have a need for additional sections, please contact the team through the support form, so we can start working together to make the design system even better!
